text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 429s + increased p95 latency for inference endpoints in us-west-2. Window=3m, error-rate=7.1%, p95=1.2s.

micah: oncall micah here. quick summary? which routes most affected?

ops-bot: breakdown: embeddings traffic spike (sustained) from small set of API keys; chat route spiky but manageable; rerank calls causing backend contention when combined with embeddings. Top issues: per-route queueing and memory pressure on nodepool-embeds.

leo: paging infra @maya. I see a handful of keys issuing thousands of small parallel embedding requests. Embedding worker queue depth up x6.

maya: thanks. can we throttle at gateway? recommend route limits rather than scaling immediately.

oliver: propose immediate soft caps: embeddings -> 3 req/s per key (burst 15), chat -> 30 req/s per key (burst 150), rerank -> disable (respond 503 with friendly message) until stable. Also reject embedding batch requests > 1024 vectors.

micah: agree. include explicit Retry-After header and reason id. Add telemetry tag inc-1898801234. Also ensure dedicated/reserved keys not affected.

leo: creating rate-limit overrides. patch:

```yaml
# gateway temporary rate limits for incident 1898801234
limits:
  - route: /v1/embeddings
    per_key: 3
    burst: 15
    max_batch_vectors: 1024
    error_code: 429
    response_header: "Retry-After"
  - route: /v1/chat/completions
    per_key: 30
    burst: 150
    error_code: 429
  - route: /v1/rerank
    limit_global: 0
    action: 503
    message: "temporarily disabled to protect platform (inc-1898801234)"
```

leo: applying to canary (10% us-west-2) now.

ops-bot: canary metrics (60s): embeddings 429s down 65% in canary, p95 latency down 350ms. No CPU/GPU anomalies.

maya: good. roll to 100% over 3 minutes if stable. micah, notify CS and affected customers.

support-bot: queued outbound note to top affected keys: cust-x, cust-y. Includes recommended client changes: reduce parallelism, exponential backoff, batch vector size reductions.

micah: rolling to 100% in 3m. also running script to apply progressive throttles to offending keys so we don't kill all of their traffic at once.

oliver: command used: 
```
./infra-cli ratelimit apply --incident 1898801234 --region us-west-2 --file tmp/rl-1898801234.yaml --canary 10
```

leo: after roll (4m): region-wide 429s down 70%, embeddings worker queue normalized. Some customers still hit 429s, but that's expected. No increase in 5xx.

micah: enforce exception for dedicated: if key.meta.plan == "dedicated" -> per_key=200. Confirmed.

maya: added server-side rejection for oversized batches with clear error: 

```json
{ "error": "batch_vectors_exceeded", "max_vectors": 1024, "incident": "1898801234" }
```

micah: made telemetry change to tag events with "inc-1898801234.quota" for easier post-incident analysis.

support-bot: cust-y replied: reduced their parallel workers after our message; reported immediate improvement.

oliver: follow-ups created: INC-1898801234-1 (per-tenant shaping), INC-1898801234-2 (rate-limit UI in Console), INC-1898801234-3 (better per-key fanout alerting).

micah: handoff to leo for monitoring. I'll remain watch for 1h. leo, please escalate to postmortem if recurrence.

leo: taking handoff. brief summary: cause = sudden high fanout of small embedding requests from a few customers; mitigation = per-route temporary quotas + batch-size enforcement + progressive throttles. Oncall until 05:30 UTC.

maya: ops note: we intentionally blocked rerank globally to free up CPU; decision review needed for customer-facing functionality impact.

micah: CS to offer pro-rated credits to any customers who had significant errors; support-bot, coordinate.

support-bot: created sales ticket and customer follow-ups for cust-x/cust-y.

oliver: additional quick-win: add a circuit-breaker that rejects >N concurrent embedding streams per key (suggest N=8) to reduce fanout from client libraries. Adding to backlog.

micah: incident status -> MITIGATED. Leaving thread open for any regression for 1h. Great work moving fast. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: incident 1898801234 status changed -> MITIGATED by micah.

leo: closing notes posted to incident log and created post-incident checklist.

support-bot: final: cust-x confirmed degraded but acceptable; cust-y asked for long-term guidance on client retries. Support will send patterns doc tomorrow.

micah: thanks all, closing handoff.
